quote: Schedule 3.6 of the MIPA lists only two Required Consents: (1) Brandywine Flats Industrial LLC (landlord) and (2) Keystone Commonwealth Bank (lender). Velloran's consent is conspicuously absent. ... Section 7.1(d) of the MIPA makes obtaining all Required Consents a condition to Buyer's closing obligation. Because Velloran's consent is not listed, it is not a closing condition. ... Add Velloran's consent to the Change of Control as a third item on Schedule 3.6. This should be done by amendment to the MIPA before closing. Simultaneously, begin the consent process with Velloran immediately.
reason: The memo identifies the sale of 100% of the membership interests as a Change of Control. It says this requires Velloran's prior written consent under Distribution Agreement § 14.2 and that § 14.3 gives Velloran a termination right if consent is not obtained. It states that Velloran's consent is missing from MIPA Schedule 3.6 and therefore from the § 7.1(d) closing condition, which satisfies the 'and/or' wording without mentioning § 6.4. It recommends adding the consent and obtaining it before closing.
